contextual_text: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk, formerly PT Adaro Energy Indonesia Tbk, reported consolidated financial position as of 31 December 2024, showing total assets of Rp 6.70T, down from Rp 10.47T in 2023. Current assets totaled Rp 2.61T in 2024, a decline from Rp 4.30T in 2023, primarily due to reduced cash and cash equivalents (Rp 1.41T vs Rp 3.31T) and inventories (Rp 100M vs Rp 171M). Non-current assets decreased to Rp 4.10T in 2024 from Rp 6.17T in 2023, reflecting a significant drop in investments in joint ventures (Rp 653.5M vs Rp 1.36T) and goodwill (Rp 39.7M vs Rp 777M). Cash and cash equivalents fell by 57% YoY, while inventories dropped 41% YoY; loans to related parties rose to Rp 2.18M in 2024 (from zero in 2023). Total assets declined by 36% YoY, primarily driven by asset impairments and strategic divestments.
